title: Structure and Liftoff in Combustion Experiment (SLICE)
scientific_focus: Laminar diffusion flames; flame structure and liftoff
objectives: Understand stability, lift-off, and visible structure of gas jet diffusion flames without strong buoyancy effects, with an emphasis on computationally tractable configurations.
approach: Produce gas-fueled laminar coflow diffusion flames in microgravity and vary burner/flow conditions. Record flame shape and lift-off behavior for model comparisons.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
